# Get Attendee Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given event attendee.

## Syntax

~~~~text
attendeeDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, attendee: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
attendeeDetail(detail: Name, attendee: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
